verification.mobile: flutter analyze: no issues; flutter test: 85 passed; iOS simulator, Android debug APK and standard web builds succeeded.
verification.nativeInteraction: Both apps installed/launched and exercised through Orca emulator: start, actual system permission dialog, GPS sample delivery, pause/resume and stop. Initial launch did not request location.
verification.api: npm run check:api and npm run build:api passed. 64 tests passed on the host, including real isolated PostgreSQL transactions and operational geometry validation. The pinned Node 22.23.2 Compose server was restarted and its actual readiness/driving-bundle routes verified.
verification.compose: docker compose up -d --wait: PostgreSQL, Redis and API healthy. Migration executed before API startup.
verification.dependencyFailure: Redis stopped: /healthz HTTP 200 and /readyz HTTP 503 redis unavailable; Redis restarted: /readyz HTTP 200.
verification.withoutProviderKeys: Compose /readyz reports all three missing provider keys while database and Redis remain ready. GET /v1/driving-bundle returns catalog:null. Normal native apps show unsupported coverage, not replay data or a fabricated countdown.
verification.python: Provider probe 10, spatial audit 11 and contract checker 5 tests passed. Golden replay validated with 8 scenarios and 4 negative cases.
verification.ci: Workflow pins Flutter/Node/Python, installs geographiclib, exercises PostgreSQL transactions, shared mobile tests, Android/web and iOS simulator builds. Remote workflow result is tracked separately; local success is not a claim of remote success.

run.android: adb -s <android-emulator-id> reverse tcp:3000 tcp:3000; cd apps/mobile && flutter run -d <android-emulator-id> --dart-define=API_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3000
run.configuration: API_BASE_URL is a build-time public endpoint only; provider keys never enter the mobile build. HTTP is accepted only for debug loopback/emulator hosts; production endpoints require HTTPS.

productionBoundary: Development runtime is functional. This does not approve a production signal feed, road/stop-line geometry, timing units, field calibration or release signing. No fake operational signal or countdown is provided.
